description: Dimitrios Nerantzis publishes five water-supply network input files in EPANET INP format. Zenodo provides one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. An INP network can supply junction, pipe, tank, pump and demand settings to a hydraulic simulator, so the five cases offer possible test networks for pressure, flow or resilience experiments. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this five-network deposit. A limitation is that the public page does not name the systems, node counts, geographical origin, observation period or whether the files contain controls and demand patterns. These may be study networks, not current utility assets. The ZIP was not downloaded; the actual INP contents, ability to run with EPANET and resulting hydraulic states were not checked. Users should inspect those details before treating any case as a calibrated real network.
